purpose: Adherence scoring (SPEC 12.2): is a task an agent reported consistent with a rule the person set? INPUTS ONLY, drafted by Claude Code. Every label is Lia's to write (SPEC 12.1). No expected answers are given or implied here. A good case is one two careful people would label the same way; reword or drop any that fail that test.
